meta.description: Opportunity Engine: busca candidatos, calcula score determinístico, aplica threshold (>=70). IA só depois.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.*,
  s.avg_price_30d,
  s.min_price_30d,
  s.max_price_30d,
  s.samples_30d,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM coupons c
    WHERE c.active = TRUE
      AND (c.product_id = p.id OR c.category = p.category)
      AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at > NOW())
  ) AS has_active_coupon
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN v_product_price_stats s ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.active = TRUE
  AND p.last_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
  AND (p.opportunity_score IS NULL OR p.last_seen_at > COALESCE(p.ai_classified_at, '1970-01-01'))
ORDER BY p.last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
UPDATE products SET opportunity_score = $1 WHERE id = $2;
UPDATE products SET opportunity_score = $1, ai_publishable = FALSE WHERE id = $2;
